title: Colonic Confessions
summary: Episode 80 is both a health-misinformation case study and a production manifesto. It opens with the limited vinyl release of Bobby Trivia's Off the Sidelines and Into the Limelight, merchandise logistics and an apology for crowding trivia out of the prior recordings. A marketed pheromone product becomes the frame for intimate anecdotes, followed by unusually direct disclosures about self-induced vomiting, ipecac and colon hydrotherapy. The archive does not convert those anecdotes into advice: poison-control authorities no longer recommend home ipecac, and NCCIH finds insufficient evidence for colon irrigation while warning of potentially serious harms. The episode also repeats the unsupported John Wayne retained-waste legend and reports Michael Jackson's propofol use too casually; both are corrected in context. A private partner's medical details are withheld because a participant says they had agreed not to discuss them. The final producer audition contains the episode's strongest durable idea: the operation needs professional execution without sanding away the project's strange, unscripted identity. Named dialogue remains withheld until held-out multispeaker validation passes.
source_notes: NCCIH reports insufficient evidence for colon irrigation and warns that adverse effects can be serious.
Poison Control says ipecac is no longer recommended for home poisoning treatment and chronic misuse can cause fatal heart problems.
The John Wayne impacted-meat/feces autopsy story lacks reliable supporting evidence and is retained only as a corrected urban legend.
Los Angeles County coroner materials identify acute propofol intoxication, with sedative contribution, in Michael Jackson's death; the episode's casual 'sleep' framing is incomplete.
Grove Atlantic confirms Asa Akira's Insatiable: Porn—A Love Story was published May 6, 2014.
Four exact private-person spans are filed in the shared redaction layer. One is governed by an explicit on-air objection.
All three cleaner drops are empty zero-duration artifacts.
speaker_policy: Named dialogue remains withheld. The file contains 2,590 window embeddings but zero diarized turns, and no independently held-out multispeaker identity validation has passed. Public participant names may appear in summaries and entity metadata without assigning every line.
sensitivity: Eating-disorder behavior; unsafe health claims; ipecac misuse; colon hydrotherapy; private partners' sexual and medical details; explicit sex; consent hypotheticals; racial and religious stereotyping; violent dream; real-world fight anecdotes; drug use; anesthesia and suicide language; workplace pressure; home-address concern; public audition and social handle.
